thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Incident INC-20260402-77 detected: sustained p99 latency increase in us-east-1 runtime pool (15m). Auto-alerting.

emily ross: I'm primary oncall this shift. Seeing the alert, starting triage. Any infra noise?

devops-matt: Autoscaler logs show repeated scale-down then immediate scale-up for runtime-pool-us-1 between 11:18-11:25 UTC. Some pods restarted with CrashLoopBackoff. Node churn visible on three nodes.

runtime-oncall: CrashLoopBackoff could be runtime process OOM or model load failures. I'm checking GC and model load logs. If it's model load, we can enable fallback routing to smaller quantized model.

emily ross: @runtime-oncall please check KV cache pressure and prefix cache evictions. If cache churn is high, that could balloon latencies.

runtime-oncall: cache hit-rate dropped from 92% to 67% for affected shard. KV cache logs show many evictions coincident with pod restarts. Potentially memory leak in latest agent.

devops-matt: I'm going to cordon the flapping nodes and scale the ASG +3 temporarily. Command: ```aws autoscaling set-desired-capacity --auto-scaling-group-name runtime-asg-use1 --desired-capacity $(current + 3)``` and then cordon/drain problematic nodes: ```kubectl cordon node-07-use1 && kubectl drain node-07-use1 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30```

security-oncall: jumping in to check if this is a DoS or credential abuse. Auth logs show normal volumes, no burst of API key failures. No new IP anomalies in guardrails. Marking SEC-INV: low for now.

support-sara: Customer reports: elasticsearch ingestion timeouts from a handful of accounts in us-east-1; CS has opened tickets for top 3 affected. We're drafting status page copy.

emily ross: Impact summary for handoff: partial latency for subset of users in us-east-1, no widespread 5xx observed yet. P2. Runbook pointer: https://redwood.runbooks/oncall/latency-mitigation -> steps 1-5.

runtime-oncall: Temporary mitigations I'm applying: 1) enable model fallback for latency-sensitive routes to redwood-small-v2 for flagged customers; 2) reduce KV cache retention on affected shards to free memory; 3) restart runtime agents after graceful drain. Fallback command (internal): ```POST /admin/routing/fallback {"route":"gen","target":"redwood-small-v2","selector":"tag:latency-sensitive"}```

devops-matt: Nodes cordoned and drained for node-07-use1, node-12-use1. ASG scale request submitted. Monitoring pod restarts now.

emily ross: Cross-team routing note: if it's model-level degrade/rollback use runtime-oncall. If it's node/cluster instability use eng-infra/devops. If we see auth anomalies escalate to security-oncall. Support should coordinate customer comms.

support-sara: Noted. Also flagging coverage gap Friday 23:00-03:00 UTC where we only have one engineer scheduled for infra. We need a volunteer for backup for 00:00-02:00.

tasha: I can take backup 00:00-02:00 Friday. @emily ross please add to oncall calendar and note in handoff.

emily ross: Adding to calendar. Handoff plan: I'm primary until 12:30 UTC, then @tasha becomes primary for observability across regions, @runtime-oncall will be secondary. Leave a one-hour overlap.

security-oncall: Also add rule: if latency correlates with increased outbound connections or unexplained subprocesses, escalate immediately. Include audit of kernel logs.

oncall-bot: Update: ASG scale +3 requested -> new instances provisioning. Pod restarts decreasing. p99 improved from 3.7s -> 1.4s after fallback + scale. Monitoring for 20m.

emily ross: Good. Before handoff: confirm fallback settings, ASG healthy, affected nodes quarantined, customer tickets created, and postmortem flag set if >5% user impact or any 5xx.

runtime-oncall: Leaving note in runbook: suspected memory leak in agent v1.4.2 when handling large prefix caches; file follow-up bug to eng-runtime and schedule canary rollback.

devops-matt: Filing infra ticket to investigate ASG scale-down policy that caused oscillation. Suggest bump cooldown and add stabilization metric for pod readiness.

support-sara: Customers notified on status page and top accounts received PMs.

emily ross: Handoff to @tasha now. Thanks everyone for quick triage. :thumbsup:

tasha: Taking over as primary. I'll monitor the mitigation window and coordinate post-incident tasks if needed.

oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260402-77 -> mitigated. Resolution start: 1972000480
